name: Be a Director 🎥✨
desc:
Welcome to Clip Tycoon! 🎥🎉

Starting with nothing more than a garage and some budget video gear, you’ll build your small recording business step by step into a real success!

💻 Build your studio step by step!
📸Record content!
✂️Edit the recording into clips!
💸Upload them and earn money!
📈 Upgrade equipment  to boost earnings!
👑Hire cameramans editors and directors!
💾 Progress automatically saves!
   
👍 Don’t forget to like & favorite the game!
